addressed_threats.statement_marker: Untrusted content is declared as reaching an external action
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It cannot discover undeclared paths or stop a separate runtime.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: Confidential or conditional data is declared as reaching an external action
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It does not implement approval or verify real identity.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: A high-impact path requires approval but lacks a clear boundary declaration
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It cannot prove a queue, approver identity, authorization artifact, or runtime validation exists.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: A policy weakens or a new flow is added
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: PR diff rendering is a future integration.
The scenario covers only its declared labels, not full model behavior.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: An ordered policy rule is unreachable or a default permits unmatched paths
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It does not establish whether the policy intent is correct or enforce a runtime decision.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: A candidate manifest introduces an external/sensitive tool or changes a policy decision
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It cannot discover undeclared behavior or determine business authorization.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: A local trace records an undeclared source, tool, flow, denied call, or approval-required call
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It cannot establish trace authenticity, completeness, actor identity, or incident cause.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: Trace evidence contains sensitive message content or tool arguments
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: The trace source itself may still require separate data-governance controls.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: MCP metadata drifts from manifest tool declarations or action classes
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It cannot discover an undeclared server capability or prove runtime enforcement.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: Review findings need to enter a compatible static-analysis evidence workflow
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It does not upload a finding, enable code scanning, prove consumer compatibility, or create a runtime control.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: An HTTP MCP profile omits an authorization expectation
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It does not validate OAuth, token audience, consent, or a real server policy.

addressed_threats.statement_marker: A generated evidence document is manually edited
addressed_threats.residual_limit_marker: It cannot prove the original operator or protect unsigned files from replacement.

residual_risks.statement_marker: Prompt-injection payloads in real documents or model context.
residual_risks.exclusion_reason: TrustWeave evaluates supplied declarations and pre-recorded metadata; it does not parse live model context or execute a model.

residual_risks.statement_marker: Malicious MCP servers, skills, packages, plugins, or repository content.
residual_risks.exclusion_reason: TrustWeave does not connect to, discover, install, import, or invoke third-party servers or extensions.

residual_risks.statement_marker: Credential theft, data exfiltration, endpoint compromise, persistence, or malware.
residual_risks.exclusion_reason: The product does not access credentials, endpoints, or live execution environments.

residual_risks.statement_marker: Network vulnerabilities, cloud misconfiguration, IAM errors, or authorization bypass in a live environment.
residual_risks.exclusion_reason: Live infrastructure assessment is deliberately outside the local declaration-review boundary.

residual_risks.statement_marker: Policy bypasses in an agent runtime that has not integrated a future TrustWeave enforcement adapter.
residual_risks.exclusion_reason: TrustWeave generates evidence for human review and does not act as an enforcement adapter.

residual_risks.statement_marker: Tampering by an actor that can modify all generated files and regenerate the local attestation.
residual_risks.exclusion_reason: Unsigned local hash relationships cannot establish an external identity or resist full local replacement.

residual_risks.statement_marker: Model deception, model hallucination, or agent-planning behavior.
residual_risks.exclusion_reason: TrustWeave does not call, inspect, or control a model or agent planner.

controls.control_statement: Typed manifest and policy evaluation produces deterministic findings for declared source-to-tool flows.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any manifest, policy, rule, or decision-semantics change.
controls.known_limit: Findings cover only supplied declarations and do not discover or stop a live path.

controls.control_statement: Policy review identifies declared high-impact flows that lack a clear approval-control boundary.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any approval-control, policy-review, or high-impact action-class change.
controls.known_limit: The review cannot prove a queue, approver identity, authorization artifact, or runtime enforcement.

controls.control_statement: Bundle diff renders declared source, tool, path, rule, and decision changes as reviewable local evidence.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any bundle identity, diff rendering, candidate-review, or output-schema change.
controls.known_limit: The diff cannot discover undeclared behavior or determine business authorization.

controls.control_statement: Synthetic scenarios produce deterministic expected-decision regression evidence from declared labels.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any scenario schema, expected-decision, or synthetic pattern-library change.
controls.known_limit: Scenario evidence covers only its declared labels and not full model behavior.

controls.control_statement: Deterministic policy review detects shadowed rules and review-sensitive default decisions.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any policy ordering, default-decision, or rule-predicate change.
controls.known_limit: The review does not determine whether a declared policy intent is correct or enforce it.

controls.control_statement: Offline trace review compares minimized local trace metadata with declared manifests and policy.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any trace schema, declaration comparison, review finding, or rendered trace-report change.
controls.known_limit: Trace review cannot establish trace authenticity, completeness, actor identity, or incident cause.

controls.control_statement: Trace-review reports retain only counts, declared names, action classes, decisions, and finding identifiers.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any trace field, report template, or privacy-minimization change.
controls.known_limit: The original local trace may still require separate data-governance controls.

controls.control_statement: MCP profile review compares saved local metadata and declared tool mappings without discovery, transport access, or token handling.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any MCP metadata, profile rule, transport-expectation, or tool-mapping change.
controls.known_limit: The review cannot discover undeclared server capability, validate OAuth, or prove runtime enforcement.

controls.control_statement: Local SARIF conversion produces deterministic portable review evidence without upload or new security conclusions.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any SARIF conversion, location, fingerprint, or static-analysis interoperability change.
controls.known_limit: Local SARIF does not upload a finding, enable code scanning, or create a runtime control.

controls.control_statement: Local attestation and verification bind canonical evidence payloads and, when supplied, exact local artifact bytes.
controls.maintenance_trigger: Any attestation schema, canonicalization, verifier, or exact-file binding change.
controls.known_limit: Unsigned local integrity evidence cannot identify the original operator or resist complete local replacement.
